exact_statement: For every nonempty parity core chi_A on m>=1 uniform data bits, k=|A|, every point y*, and r>=1 fresh point controls, put p=2^-r,t=2^-m,rho=4pt. For F=chi_A(1-2 1_x* 1_y*), the actual data marginal is q=(1-rho)delta_A+rho U_m. Given any full positive finite-cost data subprobability R of mass s<=1 and source cost c=log2(1/R(A)), the explicit repair Rprime=(1-rho)R+rho U_m and true conditional selector lift Qprime have mass (1-rho)s+rho and exact cost (1-rho)c+rho m+h2(rho)-H(J|T)-kappa+B, debt (1-rho)c-kappa, and CE<=c+6(C+E)+6I_sel, where C=2pt(m-k), E=2ptk, I_sel=2rpt. Thus K I(F)-CE>=S_K+(K-6)C-(K+6)E+(K-6)I_sel with S_K=Kk-c spent once. Any independent Boolean terminal retains its entire prescribed product-reference cost and debt. Conversely on fixed m4,k2,r1, full positive normalized references R_L(A)=1-15*2^(-L-4), R_L(T)=2^(-L-4) elsewhere have source cost<1 and unchanged-reference lift CE>=15(L+4)/128 while I(F)=33/16 and C=E=1/8. Hence no uniform finite inherited-reference payment follows from bounded source slack and finite physical edge charges alone. At L256 CE>=975/32>8I. This is a reference obstruction and paid repair, not FEI or arbitrary-core reference existence; integer rounding is separate.
hypotheses: Uniform finite Boolean cubes; nonempty character core and fresh independent point controls; every point allowed
Full data subprobability reference positive on every data subset with finite inherited cost; its mass is retained
J is an analytical mixture label, not a physical selector or fair-child representation
Physical created and erased edges are separate accounts; one inherited source slack is spent once
Optional arbitrary terminal tensor uses independent data and its full prescribed finite-cost reference
Ideal costs in bits; no universal source-reference bound, arbitrary-core floor payment or integer rounding asserted
refutes: Exploratory unchanged-reference point-edit payment from bounded source slack plus bounded physical edge accounts, uniformly over supplied full positive references. No accepted claim is identified as false.
